title: Interactive Portfolio
subtitle: A modern and immersive web experience
description: This is the website you're viewing right now. A personal portfolio built from scratch with modern technologies, designed to deliver a smooth user experience, elegant animations, and full multilingual support.
techAstro: Main framework for static site generation with partial hydration
techTypeScript: Static typing for more robust and maintainable code
techTailwind: Utility-first CSS framework for fast and consistent styling
techAnime: Lightweight and powerful JavaScript animation library
techZod: Schema validation for the content system
architectureDesc: The portfolio follows a clean content-driven architecture. Astro enables creating optimized static pages while content is managed through typed collections with Zod, facilitating internationalization and maintenance.
designDesc: The philosophy is built on two fundamental pillars: simplicity and immediate access to the most relevant information. Every element is designed so users can find what they're looking for without friction or unnecessary distractions.
stackDesc: The tech stack is strategically chosen for being the fastest in two ways: development speed for this type of project and production performance. Astro generates ultra-fast static HTML, TypeScript accelerates development with autocompletion and error detection, and Tailwind allows styling without leaving the code.
